attrs.evidence: Fable's reconciled list had five and called them all certificates. GPT-5.6 restored measurement, reproduction and model_judgment, correctly: 'GPT, Fable and Opus agree' is evidence and is not a proof certificate, and 'GPT independently reran the executable' is reproduction and is not deduction either. THE TENTH IS THIS ROUND'S AND WAS FORCED BY THE DATA: the ledger carries four KNOWN claims and none of the nine described them honestly — a cited result is not an attestation (nothing is signed), not a model judgment (the source is a paper), and not a deductive_proof (it was not re-derived here). Leaving it out would have pushed four records into deductive_proof, which is precisely the laundering the vocabulary exists to stop. All 61 settled claims (at INV-R5) are now typed; the assignment table is written out record by record rather than defaulted from status.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6 (Mosaic audit §9). Evidence typing in the sense of proof-carrying code and of SLSA's evidence/policy separation.

readjudicated.method: redeclared_by_target — a declared design invariant is adopted deliberately, not inherited
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.statement: Evidence kinds are a closed vocabulary of ten — deductive_proof, counterexample, constructive_witness, exhaustion, statistical_certificate, measurement, reproduction, attestation, model_judgment, cited_result — and every settled claim declares which one it carries.
